about.en: Hivello is a desktop node application that lets users run several DePIN (decentralized physical infrastructure) networks from one install and routes their hardware to the most rewarding ones. HVLO is its token, an SPL token on Solana with mint Gdck9KXSSiMMhNyjUjo4sVT1GDzeZnZP2yse9jhax3GR and 8 decimals.
